secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Project Settings > Data API > Project URL). Used by the Express server for privileged account/subscription operations.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase secret API key (Project Settings > API Keys). Server-side privileged access; never exposed to the browser.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL exposed to the browser bundle. Usually the same value as SUPABASE_URL.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable (anon) key exposed to the browser bundle for Supabase Auth sign-in.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI spending insights and category suggestions (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Optional: the app falls back to canned insights and keyword matching when it is absent.
